description.fun: Pachirisu is Sinnoh's electric squirrel, a species related to Pikachu. It hides its favourite berries in tree hollows along with balls of its own shed fur that crackle with static, so would-be thieves get a shock. Pairs rub cheek pouches to share stored electricity, and it sleeps with its huge fluffy tail as a pillow. Small as it is, it has been part of a World Championship-winning team.
description.guide: Pachirisu is an Electric-type squirrel from Sinnoh that does not evolve. It makes electricity in its cheek pouches, shoots charges from its tail, and stores berries in tree hollows with balls of static-charged fur.
description.tagline: A static-charged squirrel that booby-traps its berry stash.
